description: This file demonstrates a FastAPI application that processes incoming POST requests to send notifications. It employs background tasks to log messages asynchronously, and has dependency injection for query parameter handling.

methods.name: write_log(message: str)
methods.description: Function that appends a message to a log file.

methods.name: get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Dependency function that retrieves a query parameter and schedules a log writing task if present.

methods.name: send_notification( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Annotated[str, Depends(get_query)] )
methods.description: API endpoint to send a notification email and log the action asynchronously.

ctags.name: get_query
ctags.pattern: /^def get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str | None = None):$/

ctags.name: send_notification
ctags.signature: ( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Annotated[str, Depends(get_query)] )
